audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed between layers. Row 0 was the worst: phases[0].side said Diana while phases[0].why underneath it said "your passive-stacked autos win level 1" — the row argued with its own sentence. Rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 read "Skill" in full against Orianna/Diana/Orianna in content, and row 4 read Diana in full against "Skill" in content while content's own whys[4] described Diana's kill window.
audit.why: Levels 1-2 Diana is melee with no dash yet, against 815-range Command: Attack. From 3 Lunar Rush is live (22s at rank 1) and levels 4-5 even out behind Pale Cascade's shield. Level 6 is hers: Crescent Strike marks, Lunar Rush becomes free against a marked target, and Moonfall drags you back in from 475. First item keeps that dive lethal. At 2+ items she has to jump into your team and Command: Shockwave answers the jump.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Orianna, phases[3] stays Skill, phases[4] stays Diana with win[4] flipped from Skill to Diana to match it and to match content's own whys[4], phases[5].side = Diana, phases[6].side = Orianna — with every flipped row's why rewritten to match the verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Diana spike and carried an unsourced magnitude ("Luden's makes Q-W a third of a health bar").
audit.why: Diana's spikes are Lunar Rush arriving at 3 on 22s, falling to 14s at rank 5, and level 6 Moonfall at 100/90/80 combining with the free Lunar Rush reset.
audit.corrected: Spike line rebuilt on the dash cooldown curve and the level 6 window.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early states "Diana has no gap-closer until 6".
audit.why: Lunar Rush is her E and is available from level 3 — 22/20/18/16/14, 825 range. It is only free (no cooldown) when it targets an enemy already afflicted with Moonlight from Crescent Strike. Telling the reader she cannot close until 6 invites exactly the level 3-5 step-up that gets punished.
audit.corrected: "Lunar Rush only arrives at 3" replaces the claim, and the reset condition is stated wherever the dash is named.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[5] and spikes[2].text both credit Diana with a "reset R".
audit.why: Moonfall does not reset. The reset in her kit is Lunar Rush, which has no cooldown when dashing to a Moonlight-afflicted target. Attributing the reset to the ultimate misleads the reader about which cooldown to track.
audit.corrected: Both fields now name the free Lunar Rush.

audit.why: Crescent Strike reaches 900 against Command: Attack's 815, so Orianna does not out-range Diana's poke — she out-ranges Diana's autos and her dash commitment. whys[2] claimed the range edge outright and was softened to the true version.
audit.corrected: "she must walk in to do anything" replaces the range claim.

notes: Two real factual errors here, not just templating. First, content.early told the reader Diana has no gap-closer until 6 — Lunar Rush is her E, live from level 3 on a 22s cooldown, and it is only free against a target already marked by Crescent Strike. That is exactly backwards from what the page implied and it invites the step-up that loses the lane. Second, whys[5] and spikes[2].text both credit her with a "reset R": Moonfall has no reset; the reset is Lunar Rush. Chart: the packet itself flagged that the old chart gave Orianna 4 of 7 stages against a 46.76% win rate. Rather than invent a new chart I aligned the two layers on the reading both the packet and content's own prose support, and flipped content win[4] from Skill to Diana so it agrees with phases[4].side and with content's own whys[4] ("At 6 Moonfall plus Lunar Rush gives her the all-in kill window") — that row was self-contradicting inside the content layer alone. Ratings left where they already carried a magnitude; only the Skill rows that gained a side moved from 5/10 to 6/10. Left alone: breakdown.mid, breakdown.late and breakdown.wave — Orianna-generic rather than Diana-templated, and Diana's kit gave nothing same-length to replace them with.
